title: 육군과학화전투훈련단령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Appointment and Duties of the Commander)
(1) The Training Group shall have a Commander.
(2) The Commander shall be a general officer of the Army.
(3) The Commander shall, under the orders of the Chief of Staff of the Army, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Training Group and command and supervise its staff departments and units.
(4) Where the Commander is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances, the duties of the Commander shall be performed on his or her behalf in the order of precedence prescribed by the standing orders of the unit.
